entities.summary: Vikientsi Ravinski (b. 1786-10-05, Dukhovshchinsky Uyezd) was a journalist or media commentator of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Dukhovshchinsky Uyezd. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
